svg.text: Zero-Trust-Architecture: Azure hub-and-spoke, three-tier reference design
Private endpoints segmented by trust boundary: each subnet's NSG admits only the callers that need it
Backend pool = web app via PE, 443
443 to web app, Key Vault and ACR endpoints
Egress 443 via Firewall (FQDN allow-list) · runner polls workflow queue
SQL: spoke · Web: hub · KV, ACR: both
Legend: traffic flows and deployment layers
Users reach the WAF (HTTP redirects to HTTPS)
WAF backend pool is the web app, reached through its private endpoint
Gateway identity fetches its TLS certificate from the Key Vault endpoint
Web app calls the app tier through the internal LB (80 to 3000)
App tier reaches SQL on 1433; only AppSubnet may enter DataSubnet
Runner deploys to the web, Key Vault and ACR endpoints (443)
All egress is forced through Azure Firewall
Admin SSH via Bastion (rule in place; host currently disabled)
Deny-all NSGs: 6 (AppGW, Web, App, DB, Infra-PE, Web-PE)
OIDC tokens only for the 'production' environment
